```{r load}
## GSE216831 -- Vijjamarri et al. 2023 (eLife)
## Raw counts extracted to tables/GSE216831/
## Data types:
##   T_RNA -- total RNA-Seq: WT, dcp2D, xrn1D (duplicates) -- KEY for GBA
##   RNA   -- mRNA RNA-Seq:  WT, dcp2D, dcp2-EE (duplicates)
##   Ribo  -- ribosome profiling: WT, dcp2D, dcp2-EE (duplicates)
##
## Conditions:
##   dcp2D   -- Dcp2 deletion (decapping enzyme)
##   xrn1D   -- Xrn1 deletion (5'-3' exonuclease)
##   dcp2-EE -- Dcp2 catalytic mutant
##
## All strains grown in YPD at 30C to OD600 ~0.6
## NOTE: deletion mutants in replete media, not AID depletion in G1-arrested cells
## Conditions differ from our EU pulse-chase data -- interpret correlations with caution

read_counts <- function(data_dir, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) stop(paste("No files found for pattern:", pattern))
  files %>%
    map(function(f) {
      df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
      colnames(df)[1] <- "gene_id"
      df %>% mutate(gene_id = str_trim(gene_id))
    }) %>%
    purrr::reduce(full_join, by = "gene_id")
}

data_dir <- "../tables/GSE216831/"

## T_RNA -- total RNA-Seq (key for GBA)
t_rna_wt   <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_T_RNA_WT")
t_rna_dcp2 <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_T_RNA_dcp2D")
t_rna_xrn1 <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_T_RNA_xrn1D")

## RNA-Seq (for TE calculation with Ribo)
rna_wt     <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_RNA_WT")
rna_dcp2   <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_RNA_dcp2D")

## Ribo profiling (for TE calculation)
ribo_wt    <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_Ribo_WT")
ribo_dcp2  <- read_counts(data_dir, "RawCounts_Ribo_dcp2D")

cat("T_RNA WT genes:",    nrow(t_rna_wt),   "\n")
cat("T_RNA dcp2D genes:", nrow(t_rna_dcp2), "\n")
cat("T_RNA xrn1D genes:", nrow(t_rna_xrn1), "\n")
cat("RNA WT genes:",      nrow(rna_wt),     "\n")
cat("Ribo WT genes:",     nrow(ribo_wt),    "\n")
```

```{r deseq2_t_rna}
## Differential expression: dcp2D vs WT and xrn1D vs WT
## Using T_RNA (total RNA-Seq) counts
## log2FC > 0 in dcp2D vs WT = transcript stabilised when Dcp2 lost = Dcp2 target
## log2FC > 0 in xrn1D vs WT = transcript stabilised when Xrn1 lost = Xrn1 target

## Build count matrix
gene_ids <- t_rna_wt$gene_id

count_matrix <- cbind(
  t_rna_wt   %>% select(-gene_id),
  t_rna_dcp2 %>% select(-gene_id),
  t_rna_xrn1 %>% select(-gene_id)
) %>% as.matrix()

rownames(count_matrix) <- gene_ids
colnames(count_matrix) <- c("WT_1", "WT_2",
                             "dcp2D_1", "dcp2D_2",
                             "xrn1D_1", "xrn1D_2")

## Remove genes with zero counts across all samples
keep <- rowSums(count_matrix) > 0
count_matrix <- count_matrix[keep, ]
cat("Genes retained after zero filter:", nrow(count_matrix), "\n")

## Sample metadata
col_data <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(c("WT", "WT", "dcp2D", "dcp2D", "xrn1D", "xrn1D")),
  row.names = colnames(count_matrix))

## DESeq2
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = ~ condition)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

## dcp2D vs WT
res_dcp2 <- results(dds,
                    contrast = c("condition", "dcp2D", "WT"),
                    alpha    = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT = log2FoldChange,
                padj_dcp2D         = padj,
                pval_dcp2D         = pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT, padj_dcp2D, pval_dcp2D)

## xrn1D vs WT
res_xrn1 <- results(dds,
                    contrast = c("condition", "xrn1D", "WT"),
                    alpha    = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT = log2FoldChange,
                padj_xrn1D         = padj,
                pval_xrn1D         = pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT, padj_xrn1D, pval_xrn1D)

cat("dcp2D sig genes (padj < 0.05):",
    sum(res_dcp2$padj_dcp2D < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("xrn1D sig genes (padj < 0.05):",
    sum(res_xrn1$padj_xrn1D < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\ndcp2D vs WT log2FC summary:\n")
summary(res_dcp2$log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT)
cat("\nxrn1D vs WT log2FC summary:\n")
summary(res_xrn1$log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT)
```

```{r te}
## Translation efficiency from RNA-Seq + Ribo profiling
## Read files individually rather than using read_counts to avoid join issues

read_single <- function(f) {
  df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  colnames(df)[1] <- "gene_id"
  df %>% mutate(gene_id = str_trim(gene_id))
}

files_rna_wt    <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "RawCounts_RNA_WT",    full.names = TRUE)
files_rna_dcp2  <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "RawCounts_RNA_dcp2D", full.names = TRUE)
files_ribo_wt   <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "RawCounts_Ribo_WT",   full.names = TRUE)
files_ribo_dcp2 <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "RawCounts_Ribo_dcp2D",full.names = TRUE)

rna_wt_1   <- read_single(files_rna_wt[1])
rna_wt_2   <- read_single(files_rna_wt[2])
rna_dcp2_1 <- read_single(files_rna_dcp2[1])
rna_dcp2_2 <- read_single(files_rna_dcp2[2])

ribo_wt_1   <- read_single(files_ribo_wt[1])
ribo_wt_2   <- read_single(files_ribo_wt[2])
ribo_dcp2_1 <- read_single(files_ribo_dcp2[1])
ribo_dcp2_2 <- read_single(files_ribo_dcp2[2])

## Join by gene_id then convert to matrix
gene_ids_common <- purrr::reduce(
  list(rna_wt_1$gene_id, rna_wt_2$gene_id,
       ribo_wt_1$gene_id, ribo_wt_2$gene_id),
  intersect)

get_counts <- function(df, genes) {
  df %>% filter(gene_id %in% genes) %>%
    arrange(gene_id) %>%
    pull(2)
}

rna_mat <- cbind(
  get_counts(rna_wt_1,   gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(rna_wt_2,   gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(rna_dcp2_1, gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(rna_dcp2_2, gene_ids_common))
rownames(rna_mat) <- sort(gene_ids_common)
colnames(rna_mat) <- c("WT_1", "WT_2", "dcp2D_1", "dcp2D_2")

ribo_mat <- cbind(
  get_counts(ribo_wt_1,   gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(ribo_wt_2,   gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(ribo_dcp2_1, gene_ids_common),
  get_counts(ribo_dcp2_2, gene_ids_common))
rownames(ribo_mat) <- sort(gene_ids_common)
colnames(ribo_mat) <- c("WT_1", "WT_2", "dcp2D_1", "dcp2D_2")

## Remove zero rows
keep <- rowSums(rna_mat) > 0 & rowSums(ribo_mat) > 0
rna_mat  <- rna_mat[keep, ]
ribo_mat <- ribo_mat[keep, ]

## Library-size normalisation
sf_rna  <- colSums(rna_mat)  / mean(colSums(rna_mat))
sf_ribo <- colSums(ribo_mat) / mean(colSums(ribo_mat))

rna_norm  <- sweep(rna_mat,  2, sf_rna,  "/")
ribo_norm <- sweep(ribo_mat, 2, sf_ribo, "/")

df_te <- tibble(
  gene_id          = rownames(rna_norm),
  rna_mean_wt      = rowMeans(rna_norm[,  c("WT_1", "WT_2")]),
  ribo_mean_wt     = rowMeans(ribo_norm[, c("WT_1", "WT_2")])) %>%
  mutate(TE_vijjamarri_WT = log2(ribo_mean_wt / rna_mean_wt)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(TE_vijjamarri_WT)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, TE_vijjamarri_WT)

cat("Genes with TE estimate:", nrow(df_te), "\n")
summary(df_te$TE_vijjamarri_WT)
```

```{r combine}
## Combine into one GBA reference table
## gene_id               -- systematic yeast gene name (YAL012W format)
## log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT    -- log2FC in T_RNA dcp2D vs WT (positive = Dcp2 target)
## padj_dcp2D            -- adjusted p-value for dcp2D effect
## log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT    -- log2FC in T_RNA xrn1D vs WT (positive = Xrn1 target)
## padj_xrn1D            -- adjusted p-value for xrn1D effect
## TE_vijjamarri_WT      -- log2 TE in WT from Ribo/RNA-Seq

df_gba <- res_dcp2 %>%
  full_join(res_xrn1, by = "gene_id") %>%
  left_join(df_te,   by = "gene_id")

cat("GBA reference table genes:", nrow(df_gba), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(df_gba), collapse = ", "), "\n")

write_tsv(df_gba, "../tables/df_vijjamarri_gba.txt")
cat("Saved df_vijjamarri_gba.txt\n")
```

```{r qc_plots}
## QC -- distribution of log2FC values and TE
p1 <- ggplot(res_dcp2, aes(x = log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#784283", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x     = "log2 FC (dcp2D vs WT)",
       y     = "Number of genes",
       title = "mRNA abundance change after Dcp2 deletion") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p2 <- ggplot(res_xrn1, aes(x = log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#ffa8cb", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x     = "log2 FC (xrn1D vs WT)",
       y     = "Number of genes",
       title = "mRNA abundance change after Xrn1 deletion") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p3 <- ggplot(df_te, aes(x = TE_vijjamarri_WT)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#e5000c", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x     = "log2 TE (Ribo/RNA)",
       y     = "Number of genes",
       title = "Translation efficiency in WT (Vijjamarri et al.)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p1 / p2 / p3

ggsave("../figures/vijjamarri_gba_qc.png",
       width = 8, height = 12, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved vijjamarri_gba_qc.png\n")
```
